cited.quote: timely promotions were given to eligible personnel
the Government issues the following guidelines for finalizing the panel placed before it

rationale: C1 only reports promotions given in the police department, not guidelines to streamline promotion cycles. C3 is a general Departmental Promotion Committee GO for Group A/B posts across departments, a broader order not about police promotion cycles. No dedicated police measure shown.

cited.quote: constitute a State and District Level Career Counseling Committee
timely promotions were given to eligible personnel

rationale: C1 forms a career counselling committee for women police (awareness, transfers), not a committee to review or restructure promotion timelines. C2 only reports promotions made. C3 and C4 are a general DPC procedure GO. No committee on police promotion timelines is shown.

cited.quote: 8 gram gold coin along with cash assistance of Rs.50,000/- for the graduates and diploma holders
Memorial Marriage Assistance Scheme is transformed as Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme

rationale: C1 and C2 show the existing 8 gram gold plus Rs.25,000 or Rs.50,000 with no rise to Rs.30,000. C4 (GO of 2022-08-02) transforms the marriage assistance scheme into a higher education scheme rather than raising the amount. No official step for the promised increase.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu constituted a Technical Sub Committee on 01.10.2021, to deliberate with regard to benefits to both
After getting consent of Kerala, Detailed Project Reports will be prepared

rationale: C1 and C2 show only preparatory steps on the Nirar-Nallar tunnel scheme: inter-state meetings, a Technical Sub Committee constituted on 01.10.2021 and correspondence with Kerala. The Detailed Project Report is still to be prepared after Kerala's consent. No sanction or tender. Weak official step, so in_progress.

cited.quote: Cooperative societies of farmers by providing subsidy assistance to purchase 5 Tractors with trailers, 5 Seedling planting machinery

rationale: C5 is the GO of 2021-11-20 sanctioning SMAM funds and sets out support to cooperative societies for 5 tractors with trailers, 5 seedling planting and 5 harvesting machines worth Rs.2.50 crore. The mechanism is subsidy, not bank guarantee, and the extract is partly worded as a proposal. Uncertain.

cited.quote: The Farmers who adopt organic farming will be encouraged with provision of inputs subsidy
The farmers taking up organic farming are being encouraged with financial assistance

rationale: C1 is a budget speech statement of intent about inputs subsidy. C2 says only that organic farmers are being encouraged with financial assistance. C3 covers certification, clusters and input production centres, and C4 and C5 are coconut manure units and rainfed area inputs. No GO providing an organic input cost subsidy.

cited.quote: Drying yards are one of the essential infrastructure for DPCs, to obtain the required moisture level

rationale: C1 to C3 describe Direct Purchase Centres, their drying yards and storage, and plans for permanent DPCs. No extract shows an official step connecting warehouses with purchase centres that have grain drying space. C4 and C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: Creation of Livelihood Parks as common Infrastructure centres for Self Help Groups

rationale: C1 and C3 create Livelihood Parks as common infrastructure for SHGs to carry out their own livelihood activities. This is a different action and group from SHGs of unemployed graduates and ITI holders carrying out village infrastructure works. C2, C4 and C5 describe general SHG support.

cited.quote: Establishment of new Horticultural College and Research Institute at Jeenur, Krishnagiri District from the academic year 2021-22
Approval is accorded for sanction/creation of the following 9 (nine) posts for the new Horticultural College

rationale: C1 and C2 are GO 250 (2021-12-17) establishing a Horticultural College and Research Institute at Jeenur with 40 students and 9 posts; land is still to be allocated. This is a college, not the promised Horticultural university on 360 acres, so materially reduced scope.

cited.quote: Modernizing public and community toilets to ensure equitable access to safe and hygienic sanitation facilities

rationale: The promise refers to an unspecified vehicle ('through this'). The extracts show only general municipal sanitation and SDG activity and a septage management GO, with no official step tied to the promised package of roads, transport, sanitation and drinking water. Related activity only.

cited.quote: First-Generation Graduate Scholarship scheme was started by the Government of Muthamizharignar Kalaignar

rationale: Extracts concern first-generation graduates only for tuition fee concession (C1 to C3) and as a scoring criterion for selecting internship students (C4). None shows a priority for first-generation graduates in government jobs.

cited.quote: City Solid Waste Action Plan (CSWAP) has been prepared for all the 158 ULBs
During the year 2022-23 and 2023-24, 156 Micro Composting Centres were sanctioned at an estimated cost

rationale: C1 and C2 report a City Solid Waste Action Plan prepared for all 158 urban local bodies and approved by the State High Powered Committee, with facilities sanctioned from 2022-23. This covers small and medium towns. The approval date is not given; the earliest dated step is 2022-23.

cited.quote: accordingly enhance the upper ceiling limit of annual family income as stipulated in Government Order

rationale: The field the graduates are to be incentivised for is not identified. The extracts show general unemployment assistance (C1, C2) and UYEGP changes (C3, C4), existing or broader schemes not tied to this commitment. No step for the specific incentive is shown.

cited.quote: 2,200 KMs of State Highways that connect District Headquarters will be widened to 4 lane roads
In the year 2021-22, widening of 255.02 km length of important State Highways to four lane at a cost of

rationale: C4 is GO 105 (2021-11-17) approving the Chief Minister's Road Development Programme to widen two-lane roads to four lane; C2 reports works taken up and partly completed. No extract shows conversion of four-lane roads to six lane, so only part of the promise is implemented.

cited.quote: corona cash relief support @ Rs.4000/- in two instalments of Rs.2000/- each (May and June 2021)
99.2% of the rice card holders availed the cash relief

rationale: C2 and C1 report Rs.4000 cash relief paid in two instalments of Rs.2000 (May and June 2021) to 2,09,81,900 rice card holders, with 99.2% availing it. Amount and beneficiaries match; the first instalment was in May 2021 rather than starting in June. The GO itself is not in the extracts.

cited.quote: Undertakings are taking concerted action to modernize the bus depots/bus terminals through commercial development

rationale: C2 mentions modernising bus depots and terminals through commercial development, not upgrading bus stations with toilets, showers, changing rooms and nursing stations for women. C1 covers fare concessions, C3 metro facilities, C4 septage guidelines and C5 bus washing. No step on the commitment.

cited.quote: Action is being taken for purchase of machineries and construction of workshed for 175 establishing a Common Facility Centre
The palm jaggery manufacturing unit was renovated at Regional Palm Products Training Centre in Cuddalore district

rationale: C1 reports action to buy machinery and build a Common Facility Centre for quality palm jaggery (Rs.40 lakh), with training planned; C3 reports a unit renovated. C2 is a budget statement of intent and C4 and C5 concern PDS sale of palm jaggery. No GO or launch of a technology upgrade scheme is shown.

The promise does not identify what is to be inquired into ('this'). The extracts are about caste certificate scrutiny committees, a child safety disciplinary procedure and labour tribunal rules; none is about an executive committee formed for this matter.

cited.quote: allotted a sum of Rs.1.79 crore for supplying of 539 Nos. of Two Wheeler fitted with Ice Box

rationale: C2 mentions an allotment for two wheelers fitted with ice boxes with subsidy (60% for women categories), a related but different item, and an allotment is not an operational step. C1 covers insulated ice boxes with FRP boats for fishermen. No scheme providing ice boxes to women fish sellers is shown.

cited.quote: To enrich the skills of students to establish and operate new business with modern technologies
is being given at this centre to students of Agriculture and Agricultural Engineering colleges to improve their skills

rationale: C3 is a GO of 2021-10-28 approving a student training programme in agribusiness covering technologies such as drones and smart farming. C4 reports a five-day training on modern agricultural machinery and technologies for agriculture college students at a state centre. Annual recurrence is only partly shown.
